entries.label: Slim mannequin
entries.prompt: Paint a slim build in the cyan skin-key family. Preserve the exact head, hand and foot positions, height, limb poses, canvas and transparency of the approved regular walk. Change body proportions only.

review.notes: Reviewed all 36 frames in both skin palettes: distinct build proportions, consistent head scale, solid arm/hand and leg/foot connections, and the complete alternating walk. One complete frame is translated two source pixels upward, without resampling or per-limb changes. Regular validation limits are unchanged. Publication waits for this build's reduced wardrobe.

entries.sourceNotes: Selected raw candidate 1; isolated fragments of at most six pixels are removed by the generic lock. The original candidates and exact prompts are retained. Frame 8 has a whole-frame integer registration correction of (0, -2), recorded with source hashes; no per-limb edits.

entries.label: Soft features
entries.prompt: Paint only this facial feature set in neutral dark brown: Soft rounded eyebrows, gently open eyes, a small nose accent and a tiny relaxed upward-curving closed smile. Keep the exact head outline, feature placement, cyan skin, bald scalp and every pose. Side profiles show only their visible eye and matching nose/mouth accents. All nine back-facing heads remain untouched. No skin-colour patches, facial hair, cosmetics or accessories.

validation.regionReason: Eyes, brows, nose and mouth are separate facial marks; every mark must remain attached to the head.
validation.visibilityReason: Facial features are invisible on the back of the head; all nine rear-facing frames must contain no feature paint.

entries.sourceNotes: New face painting on the build-specific clothed reference, reprojected as complete frames. Declared brown ink recovery separates facial feature coverage from cyan reference underpaint.

review.notes: Reviewed all 36 frames and enlarged front-facing head crops in two skin palettes. Brown ink recovery removes cyan underpaint while retaining eyebrows, eyes and mouth. Side profiles stay aligned and rear-facing heads have no feature paint. Candidate 2 replaces the oversized first face; isolated one-pixel extraction specks are removed without raising the eight-region limit.

entries.label: Waves
entries.prompt: Add soft shoulder-length wavy hair in muted violet #7a5a9a. Keep the forehead and face visible in the down-facing row; paint the back of the hairstyle in the up-facing row. Follow every existing head position. Preserve the mannequin, face and all poses exactly. Every hair highlight, shadow and edge remains in the violet key family; no natural-colour strands or details.
entries.sourceNotes: New component painting on the slim mannequin, using the generic slot mask and material extraction.

entries.label: Collared shirt
entries.prompt: Add a simple fitted collared button-front shirt with long sleeves rolled neatly to mid-forearm, in muted violet #7a5a9a, with tiny neutral buttons. Keep a tidy upper-hip-length hem overlapping the trouser waistband in every facing, painterly fabric folds, cyan #5a9a9a exposed forearms and hands, and exactly preserve all 36 poses.
entries.sourceNotes: Candidate 2 extends the shirt hem to the upper hip. Only keyed fabric and enclosed natural-colour buttons are retained; cyan mannequin pixels and exterior neutral fringe are excluded. Broad right-facing cuff occlusion has a bounded two-region policy.

review.notes: Reviewed all 36 frames in two proof palettes and an independently coloured offline bake. Checked waist overlap, arm/cuff occlusion, connected garment silhouettes, ankle coverage and raised soles. No exposed waist band or untinted material border remains. This component is held as a candidate until the reduced wardrobe is ready to publish.

entries.label: Short-sleeve tee
entries.prompt: Add a simple crew-neck tee with short sleeves ending halfway down the upper arms, a relaxed smooth cotton body, and a straight waist-length hem. All fabric, collar ribbing and sleeve hems use muted violet #7a5a9a. No logo, buttons, stripes or trim. The full-length hem reaches the upper hip and overlaps the trouser waistband in all poses, including every rear-facing cell; no exposed waist gap.

validation.regionReason: The foreground arm occludes the connection between the torso and a visible rear hem section in profile views.

entries.sourceNotes: New component painting on the slim mannequin, using the generic slot mask and material extraction.

entries.label: Straight trousers
entries.prompt: Add straight tailored trousers in muted violet #7a5a9a, with a fitted waistband, restrained painterly creases and tidy ankle cuffs. Keep the mannequin feet cyan #5a9a9a and uncovered. Preserve every alternating support-leg pose, raised knee, raised foot and planted sole of the revised walk.

validation.regionReason: A hand occludes a small hip patch in left idle; the crossing foreground foot occludes part of the rear cuff in right walking pose 7. Both visible garment regions touch the mannequin.

entries.sourceNotes: Candidate 1 retains the full waistband through the build-specific bottom mask, whose 18-pixel canonical padding reaches the natural waist. Cyan mannequin pixels are excluded from this fabric overlay.

review.notes: Reviewed all 36 frames in two proof palettes and an independently coloured offline bake. Checked waist overlap, arm/cuff occlusion, connected garment silhouettes, ankle coverage and raised soles. No exposed waist band or untinted material border remains. This component is held as a candidate until the reduced wardrobe is ready to publish.

entries.label: Knee-length skirt
entries.prompt: Add a simple knee-length A-line skirt in muted violet #7a5a9a from the waist to the knees, with painterly folds following the exact walking pose. Paint exposed lower legs and feet in cyan #5a9a9a, aligned exactly with the mannequin. No trousers or boots. Preserve torso, arms, hands and head. Keep a consistent hem length and skirt design in every frame.
entries.sourceNotes: New component painting on the slim mannequin, using the generic slot mask and material extraction.

entries.label: Walking boots
entries.prompt: Add practical ankle-high lace-up walking boots with a small folded cuff, matching the reference outfit, entirely in muted violet #7a5a9a including the shaded soles and laces. Preserve every planted and raised foot, with soles visible in the appropriate back-facing poses. Keep legs cyan and unchanged above the cuffs.

validation.regionReason: A pair of boots has two disconnected visible regions when the feet are apart. Each boot must touch its mannequin foot.

entries.sourceNotes: Candidate 3 paints fitted boots on a clothed component reference. Whole frames are re-registered through the generic pipeline. Disconnected small disconnected cuff-edge fragments of at most 16 source pixels are removed; retained boot shapes were reviewed separately. Earlier oversized candidates are retained but rejected for crossing cell boundaries. The footwear is entirely keyed fabric, so neutral trouser-cuff fringe is excluded.

review.notes: Reviewed all 36 frames in two proof palettes and an independently coloured offline bake. Checked waist overlap, arm/cuff occlusion, connected garment silhouettes, ankle coverage and raised soles. No exposed waist band or untinted material border remains. This component is held as a candidate until the reduced wardrobe is ready to publish.

entries.label: Travel jacket
entries.prompt: Add the existing short open travel jacket with notched lapels, fitted waist, small hip-length tails and rolled mid-forearm cuffs. Primary cloth is muted violet #7a5a9a; collar, lapels and cuff facings are muted green #5a9a6a. Leave the open center cyan; do not paint an undershirt. Preserve all poses.

validation.regionReason: In profile, the torso and foreground arm separate the open jacket into a main panel, far lapel, far hem and a small visible tail. Each region remains attached to the mannequin.
